sources.citation: Joachim Bodamer (1947). Die Prosop-Agnosie. Archiv für Psychiatrie und Nervenkrankheiten.
sources.notes: Foundational clinical paper coining 'prosopagnosia' from selective face-recognition deficits following bilateral occipitotemporal brain injury.

sources.citation: Hayriye Dilek Akdoğan, Ali Çağlar Turgut, Yaren Akdoğan, Fuyou Guo (2026). The German Neurologist Joachim Bodamer Who Should Be Remembered and His Legacy to Neurology: “Prosopagnosia”. Neurology India.
sources.notes: Hayriye Dilek Akdoğan (2026) empirical follow-up in Neurology India: The German Neurologist Joachim Bodamer Who Should Be Remembered and His Legacy to Neurology: “Prosopagnosia”.

sources.citation: Hadyn D. Ellis, Andrew W. Young (1990). Accounting for Delusional Misidentifications. British Journal of Psychiatry.
sources.notes: Establishes the double dissociation between overt ventral face recognition (impaired in prosopagnosia) and covert autonomic affective response (impaired in Capgras delusion).

sources.citation: M. Ramon, B. Rossion (2010). What's lost in prosopagnosia? An investigation of familiar face processing in a single-case of pure prosopagnosia working in a kindergarten. Journal of Vision.
sources.notes: M. Ramon (2010) empirical follow-up in Journal of Vision: What's lost in prosopagnosia? An investigation of familiar face processing in a single-case of pure prosopagnosia working in a kindergarten.

sources.citation: Hadyn D. Ellis, Melanie Florence (1990). Bodamer's (1947) paper on prosopagnosia. Cognitive Neuropsychology.
sources.notes: Ellis & Florence (1990 Cognitive Neuropsychology) historical translation and neuropsychological analysis of Joachim Bodamer's 1947 landmark prosopagnosia monograph.

sources.citation: Daniel Tranel, Antonio R. Damasio (1985). Knowledge Without Awareness: An Autonomic Index of Facial Recognition by Prosopagnosics. Science.
sources.notes: Demonstrates preserved skin-conductance autonomic discrimination for familiar faces in prosopagnosic patients despite absent conscious recognition.

sources.citation: Bruno Rossion (2014). Understanding face perception by means of human electrophysiology. Trends in Cognitive Sciences.
sources.notes: Rossion (2014 Trends in Cognitive Sciences) holistic right occipitotemporal face-network synthesis derived from acquired prosopagnosia lesions.
